claims.text: GTA 6 HQ is an unofficial Grand Theft Auto VI encyclopedia and field manual for Windows.

evidence.needle: An unofficial Grand Theft Auto VI encyclopedia and field manual for Windows.

claims.text: The Home page has a live wallpaper and a countdown.

evidence.needle: Home page with a live wallpaper and a countdown

claims.text: The encyclopedia has 73 entries in 12 categories; each entry has a confidence label and its sources.
The app has a zoomable map of Leonida with 15 markers.
The Field Manual is 38 pages, with two-page spreads.

evidence.needle: A 38-page printed-style manual with two-page spreads

claims.text: The setup installs for the user account only and needs no administrator access.

evidence.needle: It installs for your user account only and needs no administrator access

claims.text: The app is downloaded for Windows from github.com/xpbeats00-sudo/gta6-hq (the releases page).
The pictures and video shown in the app are Rockstar Games material; the project is not published, approved or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

evidence.needle: Not published, approved or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive

claims.text: The music file's own metadata names the track livelyfe and its producer vairaaa.
claims.source: ffprobe of audio/XPTrailersong.mp3, read on 2026-11-12 by the main session and again by the QA auditor

evidence.note: tags artist=vairaaa and a title containing livelyfe, read with ffprobe; recorded in assets.json

claims.text: The map tiles come from the GTA VI mapping community via gtadb.org, under CC BY 4.0.

evidence.needle: the GTA VI mapping community via gtadb.org, CC BY 4.0
